description:
Receipt Check: status, gas used, logs by tx hash on Ethereum mainnet. Ethereum mainnet transaction receipt via eth_getTransactionReceipt. Takes query parameter hash (transaction hash, 0x + 64 hex). Returns the node's receipt: status, block, gas used, logs.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_eth_reads_v1/eth_mainnet_tx_receipt. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_tx_receipt
